subject: Brief error flashes when using shiny app because inputs are in an inconsistent state

messages.author: 276beb20b840713c
messages.subject: Brief error flashes when using shiny app because inputs are in an inconsistent state
parts:
I've a shiny app which dynamically accepts inputs and a brief error seems to flash when the inputs change:

 Error in data.frame: arguments imply differing number of rows: 5, 4

The error immediately disappears which makes me suspect that for a brief instant the state is inconsistent while the elements are being updated. 

Is there a way to prevent this by slowing down the updates etc. while the app state becomes consistent?

I believe this is the offending code segment. The data.frame complains when its two arguments are not exactly equal length because it gets called before the second argument has updated. Any tips? 

  output$widget_quantities <- renderUI({

    code<-list()
    for( item in input$widgets)
    {
      inp_name<-paste("inp",item,sep = "_")
      inp_display_name<-paste("Quantity of",item,sep = " ")
      code<-list(code,numericInput(inp_name, inp_display_name,value=300))
    }
    return(code)
  })

  target_df<-reactive({
    
    df<-data.frame(widgets=input$widgets,quantities=unlist(reactiveValuesToList(input)[paste("inp",input$widgets,sep="_")]))
    rownames(df)<-NULL
    return(df)
    })
  
  output$output_table<-renderTable(target_df())

messages.author: ca443e6eaa0e78ed
messages.subject: Re: Brief error flashes when using shiny app because inputs are in an inconsistent state
parts:
Add the line

freezeReactiveValue(input, inp_name) above the line that starts with: code <- list(code,

This will momentarily cancel any reactives that attempt to read the input that you're (re-)creating.

Can you let me know if that fixes it, please? Thanks!
